result.topic_en: The left-hand page is blank apart from stains; only the cut-off edge of the facing page is visible, showing a table headed 'Aus den H...' that lists pairs of place names (e.g. Kalkenberg, Elmhorst, Wilsede, Litberg, Brüttendorf, Zeven, Steinberg, Bottel, Bullerberg, Bremen, Brelit, Garlste) with numerical values around +0.32, apparently from Gauss's Hanover geodetic survey.
